tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Pursuant to Scheme of Arrangement between ZEEL and INX Media Pvt Ltd (INX), broadcasting division of INX was demerged with ZEEL during AY 2010-11. However, in the assessment proceeding of INX Media, the Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax had made certain disallowance due to which the losses of INX Media were reduced. Accordingly, losses claimed by the Company had been reduced. Appeal of INX is pending with Commissioner of Income Tax. Appeal of ZEEL for AY 2011-12 is pending before Bombay High Court which has an interdependency with INX appeal matter.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Commissioner of Income tax Range (Income tax Department)
tax_litigation.status: Matter of INX is pending with CIT(A). Awaiting for next hearing date

operating_notes.text: Filed a commercial suit in Delhi High Court against Jiostar India claiming ₹28.75 Cr for copyright infringement.
Recommended dividend of ₹2 per equity share for FY25-26.
Board approved additional investment up to ₹100 Cr in Optionally Convertible Debentures of subsidiary ZBullet Enterprises Limited.
ZEE5 achieved annual EBITDA breakeven in FY26.
Launched Unite8 Sports, a portfolio of four dedicated linear sports channels.
Partnered with FIFA to bring 39 global football events to India across 2026-2034 and launched four dedicated Unite8 Sports channels.
Awarded rights to broadcast, stream and distribute 39 FIFA competitions in India from 2026 to 2034 across UNITE8 Sports and ZEE5.

timeline.summary: Zee Entertainment initiated a commercial suit against Jiostar India in the Delhi High Court on May 7, 2026, claiming ₹28.75 Cr for copyright infringement.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,024.8 Cr, net loss to shareholders ₹102.4 Cr.
Zee Entertainment reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,025 Cr and a net loss of ₹103.7 Cr.
Zee Entertainment approved an additional investment of up to ₹100 Cr in the OCDs of its subsidiary ZBullet Enterprises Limited.
Zee Entertainment reported Q4 FY26 digital revenue growth of 71% YoY to ₹470 Cr and FY25-26 digital EBITDA breakeven.
Zee Entertainment announced the launch of a dedicated sports channel portfolio named Unite8 Sports.
Zee Entertainment partnered with FIFA to broadcast 39 global football events in India from 2026 to 2034 and launched four Unite8 Sports channels.
Zee Entertainment secured broadcast, stream, and distribution rights for 39 FIFA competitions in India from 2026 to 2034.
